newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal unit resumes production.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal unit resumes production.

text.p: The 600 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the coal-fired power station in Homer City, Pa., resumed production late Monday after being shut last Thursday for repairs and maintenance, the operator said.
"Homer City 2 is at full load," said a GPU Generation Inc spokeswoman when asked about the operating status of the unit.
The unit was shut early Thursday to repair a flame scanner, which is part of the combustion control system.
The adjoining Homer City unit 1, also at 600 MW, was running at full output, the spokeswoman added.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York Electric & Gas Corp each have 50 percent stake in Homer City 2.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
